{{Top}}
'''Infrared goggles''', also called '''Infra-goggles''' or '''IR goggles''', provided better vision in darkened rooms and helped the user to see enemies while remaining hidden in the dark. [[Battery/Legends|Battery]] power was needed to make the work, so the user had to use them only when needed and turn them off when not in use.
